sentence: Group members each give three candidate rental houses 0 to 3 points on criteria like price, laundry, distance, kitchen, quiet and parking, and the card totals the points, shows the leader, and lets the host lock the result.
use_when: A group needs to pick one of a few houses or apartments to rent together
Roommates want to compare sublet options on shared criteria
Everyone should score each option separately before a final choice
A host needs to lock in a decision after people have rated
dont_use_when: The choice is a quick single-question yes/no or one-vote poll
The options are not housing, or the criteria are different from the fixed list
Splitting rent or costs between people is needed

origin.title: senior house hunt 2027
